# 5280

> > Denver's Mile High Magazine covering Colorado dining, craft beer, lifestyle, health, travel, and local culture.

5280 is Denver's premier city magazine, named after the city's elevation of 5,280 feet above sea level. The publication provides comprehensive coverage of Colorado's restaurant scene, craft breweries, outdoor adventures, fashion, health, and local events throughout the Denver metro area and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Denver dining and restaurants
- Colorado craft beer and breweries
- Wine bars and happy hours
- Colorado travel and getaways
- Health and lifestyle
- Denver local culture and events
- Colorado Springs
- Fashion and design
- Outdoor activities and skiing
- Food trucks and bakeries
- Live music and entertainment
- Local authors and books
- Vinyl records and music culture

## Denver Dining & Restaurants

- [Sips and Snacks: Caveau Wine Bar](https://5280.com/sips-and-snacks-caveau-wine-bar): Review of Caveau Wine Bar's happy hour and small plates in Denver
- [Al Fresco: Izakaya Den](https://5280.com/al-fresco-izakaya-den): Review of Izakaya Den's outdoor Japanese fusion dining on South Pearl
- [Treats: Sugar Bakeshop's Sprinkles Cookie](https://5280.com/treats-sugar-bakeshops-sprinkles-cookie): Review of Sugar Bakeshop's signature sprinkles cookie in Denver
- [Sweet Stuff: Ba-nom-a-nom](https://5280.com/sweet-stuff-ba-nom-a-nom): Profile of Ba-nom-a-nom healthy frozen treats food truck

## Colorado Craft Beer

- [Beer Review: Oskar Blues' Old Chub](https://5280.com/beer-review-oskar-blues-old-chub): Review of Old Chub scotch ale from Oskar Blues Brewing in Lyons
- [Beer Review: Bristol's Belgian-Style Ale Dubbel](https://5280.com/beer-review-bristols-belgian-style-ale-dubbel): Review of Belgian dubbel from Bristol Brewing in Colorado Springs

## Colorado Travel & Getaways

- [Getaway: Leadville](https://5280.com/getaway-leadville): Travel guide to Leadville mountain town and outdoor activities
- [Snow Biz: Aspen Ski Co. Mandates Helmets](https://5280.com/snow-biz-aspen-ski-co-mandates-helmets): Aspen Skiing Company's new employee helmet safety mandate

## Health & Lifestyle

- [Seven Ways to Fight Breast Cancer](https://5280.com/seven-ways-to-fight-breast-cancer): Breast cancer prevention tips and awareness guide for Colorado
- [Live Longer: Listen to Vinyl](https://5280.com/live-longer-listen-to-vinyl): Health benefits of vinyl records and physical activity in Denver
- [Get Home Safe this Fourth of July](https://5280.com/get-home-safe-this-fourth-of-july): Fourth of July DUI prevention and public safety tips with RTD

## Denver Arts & Culture

- [On the Download: The Dan Craig Band's "Alchemy"](https://5280.com/on-the-download-the-dan-craig-bands-alchemy): Album review of Denver's Dan Craig Band's 'Alchemy' release
- [Books: Interview with Author Chris Cleave](https://5280.com/books-interview-with-author-chris-cleave): Interview with Chris Cleave about his Olympic cycling novel 'Gold'
- [Wife, Reborn: An Update on Tricia Williford](https://5280.com/wife-reborn-an-update-on-tricia-williford): Update on widow Tricia Williford's grief memoir book deal

## Denver Local News & Events

- [On the Scene: Occupy Denver](https://5280.com/on-the-scene-occupy-denver): Coverage of Occupy Denver protest movement and tent city
- [How Cobell Came to Be Settled Under Ken Salazar](https://5280.com/how-cobell-came-to-be-settled-under-ken-salazar): Ken Salazar's role in settling Cobell Native American trust case
- [Photo of the Week: Rugged Maniacs](https://5280.com/photo-of-the-week-rugged-maniacs): Photo feature of Rugged Maniac 5K obstacle race in Lakewood

## Optional

- [Designer Spotlight: KearaJean Handbags](https://5280.com/designer-spotlight-kearajean-handbags): Profile of Denver designer Keara Jean Daly's custom leather handbags
